ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-gray field against 35% low-intensity black pigmentation and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of discrete dark-intensity sub-circular blobs (mottling) scattered across the ventral surface; density of blobs increases toward the distal tips and trailing edges, while the lower central region near the peduncle remains predominantly high-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 80-degree angle at the vertex with a deep, narrow penetration toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular and jagged; continuous high-frequency serrations and deep irregular indentations (5-15 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature on the trailing edge leading to elongated, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-intensity white circular marks (likely barnacle scars) visible on the distal tip of the left lobe (viewer's left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular fracturing and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer's right), appearing as deep, non-uniform notches.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'polka-dot' pattern composed of hundreds of small, isolated dark pigmentation spots across the light ventral field.
